caseName: Rockwood Cas. Ins. Co. v. Dir., Office of Workers' Comp. Programs
caseNameFull: ROCKWOOD CASUALTY INSURANCE COMPANY v. DIRECTOR, OFFICE OF WORKERS' COMPENSATION PROGRAMS, DEPARTMENT OF LABOR

opinions.text: Motion of respondent Tony Kourianos for attorney's fees and expenses granted. The Court approves the attorney's fees of $22,106.25 and expenses of $1,531.53.
